summary: Design and personality for every hour — the new Happy Hour series brings expressive form and everyday functionality to life. Available in versatile bench and under counter options, as well as a refined pallete of contemporary colours.
title: New Happy Hour Series - A New Mood For The Bathroom
bodyHtml:
A Playful New Expression

Design and personality for every hour — the new Happy Hour series brings expressive form and everyday functionality to life.

Compact in size but rich in presence, these Italian-made basins blend expressive silhouettes with everyday practicality.


Happy Hour 75X in Matte Sand - 750 x 380 x 150 mm

Design Freedom, Thoughtfully Delivered

From bold, bench-mounted centrepieces to discreet undercounter models, Happy Hour offers a basin for every mood and every space.

Select versions also include tap decks for added functionality, making them ideal for compact bathrooms or where spatial efficiency is key.


Happy Hour Oval 75 Undercounter - 750 x 380 x 150 mm

Italian Craftsmanship, Timeless Colours

Crafted in Italy by our newest manufacturing partner, Hatria, the Happy Hour series is a celebration of considered design and enduring craftsmanship.

A contemporary yet timeless colour range makes it effortless to pair with any material palette or interior direction.


Happy Hour Oval 57 Undercounter - 570 x 380 x 150 mm

Discover Happy Hour

Discover the collection and explore how Happy Hour can bring playful elegance and practical refinement to your next bathroom project.
